description: Create a new WhatsApp message template and submit it to Meta for review (Official WhatsApp / Cloud API workspaces only). A template is the only way to start a conversation or message a customer outside the 24-hour reply window; once Meta APPROVES it, send it with send_template. Inputs: name (lowercase letters, digits and underscores; Meta registers it as "nt_<name>"), language (any language Meta accepts for templates, e.g. "ar", "en", "es", "pt", "fr", "de", "tr"), category, body, an example value for every body placeholder, and optionally a header (text, or an image/video/document with a public sample URL), a footer and buttons. Categories: UTILITY = a message about something the customer already started (order update, booking reminder, account notice) — no promotion; MARKETING = promotions, offers, announcements, re-engagement — billed per delivered message at Meta's marketing rate. Meta decides the final category and may RE-CATEGORISE a UTILITY template that contains promotional wording as MARKETING (billed as marketing). AUTHENTICATION (one-time passcodes) cannot be authored here — the panel's custom-template editor does not author it either. Placeholders: positional {{1}}, {{2}} … numbered from 1 without gaps, OR named {{customer_name}} (lowercase) — never both in one template; pass examples as {"1": "Sara"} or {"customer_name": "Sara"}. Consent gate: call with confirm=false first — nothing is saved or sent and you get the exact payload Meta will receive; show it to the user and only call again with confirm=true after they approve. Meta reviews a submitted template within minutes up to 24 hours; the result (APPROVED / REJECTED with Meta's reason) appears in list_whatsapp_templates. This tool does not edit or delete existing templates (use the WhatsApp templates page in the panel) and does not send any message.

body.description: Message text, up to 1024 characters. Placeholders as {{1}}, {{2}} … or {{customer_name}}. A placeholder cannot be the whole message, and the body cannot start or end with one (punctuation and emojis do not count) — put real words before the first and after the last.

buttons.description: Optional, up to 10 buttons (at most 2 url and 1 phone_number). Labels max 25 characters, no emojis. quick_reply: {"type":"quick_reply","text":"Track order"}. url: {"type":"url","text":"Open","url":"https://shop.com/o/{{1}}","url_example":"https://shop.com/o/1045"} — a {{1}} is allowed only at the END of the url and then url_example is required. phone_number: {"type":"phone_number","text":"Call us","phone_number":"+966500000000"}.

category.description: UTILITY (transactional, no promotion) or MARKETING (promotional, billed per message at Meta's marketing rate). Meta may re-categorise. AUTHENTICATION is refused here.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to submit this template to Meta for review.

examples.description: Required by Meta: one realistic sample value per placeholder, keyed by the placeholder ({"1": "Sara", "2": "#1045"} or {"customer_name": "Sara"}). Also covers a named placeholder in a text header.

footer.description: Optional footer, max 60 characters, no placeholders (emojis are removed — Meta refuses them there).

header.description: Optional header. {"type": "text", "text": "Your order"} (max 60 chars; a named template may use ONE {{placeholder}} in it), or {"type": "image"|"video"|"document", "media_url": "https://…"} — a PUBLIC sample file Meta reviews (uploaded to Meta on submit); every send of the approved template must then supply its own media.

language.description: Bare language code the template is written in: one of ar, en, pt, es, fr, af, sq, az, be, bn, bg, ca, zh, hr, cs, da, prs, nl, et, fil, fi, ka, de, el, gu, ha, he, hi, hu, id, ga, it, ja, kn, kk, rw, ko, ky, lo, lv, lt, mk, ms, ml, mr, nb, ps, fa, pl, pa, ro, ru, sr, si, sk, sl, sw, sv, ta, te, th, tr, uk, ur, uz, vi, zu. A few are registered at Meta with their region ("pt" → pt_BR, "zh" → zh_CN). One template = one language; create another template for another language.

name.description: Template name: lowercase letters, digits and underscores only (e.g. "order_shipped"). Unique per workspace. Meta registers it as "nt_<name>" — that is the name list_whatsapp_templates and send_template use.

name: create_whatsapp_template
